featureOff.message: Equity & cap table is not enabled for this organization.
featureOff.remedy: Turn on Equity & cap table in Company Settings → Features.

forbidden.remedy: Ask an administrator to grant {permission} (Company Settings → Roles), then try again.

forbiddenForEntity.message: This action requires the {permission} permission for the legal entity.
forbiddenForEntity.remedy: Ask an administrator to grant {permission} and access to the legal entity (Company Settings → Roles), then try again.

entityOutsideAccess.message: The legal entity does not exist or is outside your access.
entityOutsideAccess.remedy: Choose a legal entity you can access.

entityInvalid.remedy: Choose a legal entity of this organization.

entityInactive.message: The legal entity does not exist or is inactive.
entityInactive.remedy: Choose an active legal entity of this organization.

entityCurrencyMissing.message: Legal entity {entity} has no functional currency.
entityCurrencyMissing.remedy: Set the legal entity's base currency in Company Settings → Subsidiaries.

currencyUnknown.message: Currency {currency} has no supported precision in the currency registry.
currencyUnknown.remedy: Restore {currency} in the currency registry (Company Settings → Currencies).

currencyPrecisionUnsupported.message: The currency precision is not supported.
currencyPrecisionUnsupported.remedy: Restore the currency in Company Settings → Currencies.

currencyCodeInvalid.message: Choose the currency the record is stated in.
currencyCodeInvalid.remedy: Enter a three-letter ISO currency code.

classUnknown.message: The share class does not exist for this legal entity.
classUnknown.remedy: Choose a share class of the legal entity.

classReferenceUnknown.message: A security references a share class that does not exist.

planUnknown.message: The plan does not exist for this legal entity.
planUnknown.remedy: Choose a plan of the legal entity.

roundUnknown.message: The round does not exist for this legal entity.
roundUnknown.remedy: Choose a round of the legal entity.

holderInvalid.remedy: Choose a person or company from the directory.

holderInactive.message: The holder must be an active person or company of this organization.
holderInactive.remedy: Choose an active person or company, or reactivate it in the directory.

idempotencyConflict.message: This request key was already used for a different {subject, select, round {round change} reversal {reversal} issuance {issuance} event {event} action {equity action} election {election} other {request}}.
idempotencyConflict.remedy: Retry with a new request key.

auditUnwritten.message: The audit record was not written; the change was not saved.

reasonRequired.message: Record a reason of {min} to {max} characters for {subject, select, classAmendment {the class amendment} split {the split} reserveChange {the reserve change} mfnElection {the MFN election} mfnReversal {the MFN election reversal} roundAmendment {the round amendment} roundVoid {the round void} accountPolicy {the account policy version} forfeit {the forfeiture} expire {the expiry} cancel {the cancellation} repurchase {the repurchase} void {the void} reverse {the reversal} withdrawal {withdrawing the action} other {the change}}.
reasonRequired.remedy: Describe why (for example, the board resolution that approved it), then submit again.

preMoneyBasisTooShort.message: State the basis of the pre-money valuation in {min} to {max} characters.
preMoneyBasisTooShort.remedy: Describe the basis under “{field}” (for example, a pool increase or conversions counted in the valuation), or leave it blank.

fxRateMissing.message: No {from} to {to} exchange rate is recorded on or before {date}.
fxRateMissing.remedy: Record the {from}/{to} spot rate for {date} (Setup → Exchange Rates), then try again.

fxRateUnresolved.message: No {from} to {to} exchange rate was resolved for {subject, select, conversion {the conversion} model {the model} other {the calculation}}.
fxRateUnresolved.remedy: Record the {from}/{to} spot rate for {date} (Setup → Exchange Rates), then try again.

decimalInvalid.message: “{label}” must be a plain decimal number.
decimalInvalid.remedy: Enter “{label}” as digits with an optional decimal point, such as {example}.

decimalPrecision.message: “{label}” carries more than {places} decimal {placesCount, plural, one {place} other {places}}.
decimalPrecision.remedy: Enter “{label}” with at most {places} decimal {placesCount, plural, one {place} other {places}}.

sharesInvalid.message: “{label}” must be a whole number of shares.
sharesInvalid.remedy: Enter “{label}” as a whole number of shares.

textInvalid.message: “{label}” is required, in at most {max} characters.

accountPolicyIncomplete.message: The equity account policy in force from {date} does not map “{account}”.
accountPolicyIncomplete.remedy: Add an equity account policy version that maps “{account}”, effective on or before the transaction date (Setup → Equity accounts).

accountPolicyMissing.message: No equity account policy is in force for this legal entity on {date}.
accountPolicyMissing.remedy: Add an equity account policy for the legal entity, effective on or before the transaction date (Setup → Equity accounts).

fxAccountMissing.message: The realized FX gain/loss account is not configured.
fxAccountMissing.remedy: Map the realized FX gain/loss account in Setup → Company & Accounting → Control accounts, then try again.

considerationAccountMissing.message: Choose the account the consideration settles through.
considerationAccountMissing.remedy: Choose the cash or bank account that received or paid the cash under “{field}”.

considerationAccountInvalid.message: The consideration account must be an active cash or bank posting account.
considerationAccountInvalid.remedy: Choose an active cash or bank account under “{field}”; receivables, prepaid, inventory and allowance accounts cannot receive or pay the cash.

postingRefused.message: The ledger refused the equity entry dated {date} ({reason}).
postingRefused.remedy: Resolve the ledger refusal (for example, reopen the period through Period Close or reactivate the account), then try again.

postingPeriodClosed.message: The equity entry dated {date} falls in {period}, which is closed for posting.
postingPeriodClosed.remedy: Request a controlled reopen of {closing} through Period Close, or record the transaction on a date in an open period.

bookMissing.message: The organization has no active primary book that posts to the general ledger.
bookMissing.remedy: Activate the primary accounting book in Company Settings → Accounting books.

periodMissing.remedy: Generate the accounting periods of the fiscal year that covers {date} (Setup → Period Close → Accounting periods), then try again.

entryUnbalanced.message: The equity entry dated {date} does not balance.
entryUnbalanced.remedy: Review the amounts and try again.

entryUnknown.message: The entry to reverse is not an equity entry of this organization.
entryUnknown.remedy: Reload the record and try again.

entryNotPosted.message: Entry {entry} is not a posted entry and cannot be reversed.
entryNotPosted.remedy: Reload the record; it may already be reversed.

notSaved.message: {record, select, round {The round} roundAmendment {The round amendment} roundVoid {The round void} shareClass {The share class} classAmendment {The class amendment} split {The split} plan {The plan} reserveChange {The reserve change} security {The security} event {The event} election {The election} reversal {The reversal} accountPolicy {The policy version} compensationRun {The compensation run} interestRun {The interest run} request {The equity action} other {The change}} was not saved.

notStoredCompletely.message: {record, select, compensationLines {The compensation run lines} releaseLines {The restricted stock releases} interestLines {The interest run lines} positions {The cap table positions} vesting {The vesting tranches} other {The records}} were not stored completely; nothing was saved.

positionsStale.message: The cap table position ledger was not brought up to date; nothing was saved.

issuanceEntryUnknown.message: The issuance entry of {security} does not identify its principal.
issuanceEntryUnknown.remedy: Review the instrument's issuance entry in the journal; a SAFE or note settles the principal its issuance credited.

interestUnreconciled.message: The ledger carries {carried} in accrued interest on {security}, but {accrued} has accrued to {date}.
interestUnreconciled.remedy: Review the note's interest entries in the journal; accrued interest is posted only by interest runs and settlements.

eventKindMissing.message: Choose what happened to the security.

eventNotApplicable.message: {event, select, exercise {An exercise} settle {A settlement} forfeit {A forfeiture} expire {An expiry} cancel {A cancellation} repurchase {A repurchase} transfer {A transfer} convert {A conversion} void {A void} repay {A repayment} reverse {A reversal} election_83b {An 83(b) election} other {This event}} cannot be recorded on {kind, select, share {a share certificate} option {an option} rsu {an RSU} warrant {a warrant} safe {a SAFE} note {a convertible note} other {this security}}.
eventNotApplicable.remedy: Choose an event that applies to this security.

eventSecurityVoid.remedy: A void security takes no further events; record the event on a security that stands.

eventBeforeIssue.message: The event cannot precede the issue date, {issueDate}.
eventBeforeIssue.remedy: Date the event on or after {issueDate}.

eventQuantityNotPositive.message: The quantity must be at least one share.
eventQuantityNotPositive.remedy: Enter a quantity of at least one under “{field}”.

convertibleNotOutstanding.message: Security {security} is {status, select, outstanding {outstanding} exercised {exercised} settled {settled} forfeited {forfeited} expired {expired} cancelled {cancelled} repurchased {repurchased} transferred {transferred} converted {converted} void {void} repaid {repaid} not_issued {not yet issued} other {no longer outstanding}} as of {date}.
convertibleNotOutstanding.remedy: Record a settlement only on an outstanding SAFE or note; reverse the earlier settlement first if it was recorded in error.

nothingVestedUntilNext.message: Every unit of {security} vested by {date} is already {event, select, exercise {exercised} other {settled}} or no longer outstanding; the next units vest on {nextVest}.
nothingVestedUntilNext.remedy: Set “{field}” on or after {nextVest}, when the next units vest.

nothingVestedYet.message: Nothing on {security} is vested yet on {date}; the first units vest on {nextVest}.
nothingVestedYet.remedy: Set “{field}” on or after {nextVest}, when the first units vest.

nothingVestedEver.message: No units of {security} are vested and {event, select, exercise {unexercised} other {unsettled}} on {date}, and no further units vest under its schedule.
nothingVestedEver.remedy: Review the award's history: every vested unit is already exercised, settled, forfeited or expired.

exerciseExceedsOutstanding.message: Only {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit is} other {units are}} outstanding on {date}.
exerciseExceedsOutstanding.remedy: Exercise no more than {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}}.

exerciseExceedsVested.message: Only {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit is} other {units are}} vested and {event, select, exercise {unexercised} other {unsettled}} on {date}.
exerciseExceedsVested.remedy: Record no more than {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}}; unvested units cannot be {event, select, exercise {exercised} other {settled}}.

earlyExerciseTermsMissing.message: Grant {security} does not record the price at which the company repurchases unvested shares.
earlyExerciseTermsMissing.remedy: Exercise no more than the {ceiling} vested {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}}.

exerciseBelowPar.message: The shares would be issued below par value.
exerciseBelowPar.remedy: Review the exercise price and the class's par value.

eventExceedsHolding.message: Only {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit is} other {units are}} {event, select, forfeit {unvested} expire {vested and unexercised} other {outstanding}} on {date}.
eventExceedsHolding.remedy: Record no more than {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}}.

repurchaseExceedsOutstanding.message: Only {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {share is} other {shares are}} outstanding on {date}.
repurchaseExceedsOutstanding.remedy: Repurchase no more than {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}.

restrictedRepurchaseMixed.message: {ceiling} of the shares {ceilingCount, plural, one {is} other {are}} unvested on {date}; the company repurchases unvested shares on the grant's terms.
restrictedRepurchaseMixed.remedy: Repurchase the {ceiling} unvested {ceilingCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} first, then record a separate repurchase of vested shares.

restrictedRepurchaseTermsMissing.message: Grant {grant} does not record the repurchase price of unvested shares.
restrictedRepurchaseTermsMissing.remedy: Record “{field}” on the grant's terms before repurchasing unvested shares.

repurchaseFairValueMissing.message: The grant repurchases unvested shares at the lower of cost and fair market value, so the fair market value on the repurchase date is required.

repurchasePriceFixed.message: The grant prices this repurchase at {amount}.
repurchasePriceFixed.remedy: Clear “{field}”; the repurchase price follows the grant's terms.

earlyExerciseDepositUnreconciled.message: The early-exercise deposit of {security} is not on the ledger.
earlyExerciseDepositUnreconciled.remedy: Review the exercise entry in the journal; the deposit is credited by the exercise and released by the compensation run.

repurchaseAmountNegative.remedy: Enter the cash paid for the shares under “{field}”.

transfereeIsHolder.message: The transferee is already the holder.

transferExceedsVested.message: Only {ceiling} vested {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}} can be transferred on {date}.
transferExceedsVested.remedy: Transfer no more than {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}}.

conversionNotPreferred.message: Only preferred shares convert into common.

conversionTargetMissing.message: Choose the common class the shares convert into.
conversionTargetMissing.remedy: Choose a common class of the legal entity.

conversionClassMismatch.remedy: Convert into the class's conversion class, or amend the conversion class first.

conversionClassMismatchUnnamed.message: Class {shareClass} converts into another common class.
conversionClassMismatchUnnamed.remedy: Convert into the class's conversion class, or amend the conversion class first.

conversionClassNotEffective.remedy: Date the conversion on or after {date}.

conversionExceedsHolding.message: Only {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} can convert on {date}.
conversionExceedsHolding.remedy: Convert no more than {ceiling} {ceilingCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}.

conversionBelowOneCommon.message: The shares convert into less than one common share.

conversionRoundMissing.message: Choose the round the instrument converts in.
conversionRoundMissing.remedy: Choose a round of the legal entity.

conversionOffClosingDate.message: Round {round} closed on {date}; an instrument converts in it on its closing date.

conversionTermsVoid.message: The MFN election on {security} of {electedOn} adopted the terms of {source}, which is void as of {voidedOn}.
conversionTermsVoid.remedy: Reverse the MFN election on {security}, dated on or before {closedOn} (Securities → {security} → MFN terms → Reverse election), then convert it again on the terms that stand.

conversionBelowOneShare.message: The instrument converts into less than one share.
conversionBelowOneShare.remedy: Review the round price and the instrument's terms.

convertingAmountUnreconciled.message: The converting amount of {security} does not match what the ledger carries.
convertingAmountUnreconciled.remedy: Review the instrument's issuance and interest entries in the journal.

conversionBelowPar.message: The conversion would issue shares below par value.
conversionBelowPar.remedy: Review the round price and the class's par value.

repaymentAmountMissing.message: The amount repaid must be more than zero.
repaymentAmountMissing.remedy: Enter the cash paid to the holder under “{field}”.

safeRepaymentAmount.message: A SAFE is repaid at its purchase amount, {amount}.
safeRepaymentAmount.remedy: Record the repayment at the purchase amount; record any settlement difference as a separate journal entry.

voidMfnSource.message: {safe} adopted the terms of {security} by its MFN election of {electedOn}; voiding {security} would leave that election naming terms entered in error.
voidMfnSource.remedy: Reverse the MFN election on {safe} first (Securities → {safe} → MFN terms → Reverse election), then void {security}.

voidMfnSourceConverted.message: {safe} adopted the terms of {security} by its MFN election of {electedOn}; voiding {security} would leave that election naming terms entered in error.
voidMfnSourceConverted.remedy: Void certificate {certificate}, which the conversion of {safe} produced, dated {convertedOn} (the round's closing date); reverse the MFN election on {safe} (Securities → {safe} → MFN terms → Reverse election); then void {security} and convert {safe} again.

voidHasActivity.message: Security {security} has recorded activity and cannot be voided.
voidHasActivity.remedy: Void the certificates its events produced first, reverse its other events, or record a cancellation instead.

reversalTargetUnknown.message: The event to reverse does not exist on this security.
reversalTargetUnknown.remedy: Choose an event from the security's history.

eventFinal.message: {event, select, void {A void} other {A reversal}} cannot be reversed.
eventFinal.remedy: Voids and reversals are final; record the security or event again if it is still needed.

eventNotReversible.message: {event, select, exercise {An exercise} settle {A settlement} forfeit {A forfeiture} expire {An expiry} cancel {A cancellation} repurchase {A repurchase} transfer {A transfer} convert {A conversion} void {A void} repay {A repayment} reverse {A reversal} election_83b {An 83(b) election} other {This event}} cannot be reversed.
eventNotReversible.remedy: Void the certificate the event produced instead; that undoes the event.

reversalBeforeEvent.message: The reversal cannot precede the event it reverses, dated {date}.
reversalBeforeEvent.remedy: Date the reversal on or after {date}.

reversalHasDependents.message: Later activity on {security} relies on the {event, select, forfeit {forfeiture} expire {expiry} cancel {cancellation} repurchase {repurchase} repay {repayment} election_83b {83(b) election} other {event}} of {date}: {count} later {countCount, plural, one {event} other {events}}, the latest on {latestOn}.
reversalHasDependents.remedy: Undo the later activity first, latest first, starting with the {latest, select, exercise {exercise} settle {settlement} forfeit {forfeiture} expire {expiry} cancel {cancellation} repurchase {repurchase} transfer {transfer} convert {conversion} repay {repayment} election_83b {83(b) election} other {event}} of {latestOn}: reverse each, or void the certificate it produced; then reverse this {event, select, forfeit {forfeiture} expire {expiry} cancel {cancellation} repurchase {repurchase} repay {repayment} election_83b {83(b) election} other {event}}.

election83bNotApplicable.message: Security {security} has no vesting schedule, so no 83(b) election applies.
election83bNotApplicable.remedy: Record 83(b) elections on restricted stock only.

election83bWindowClosed.remedy: An election must be filed within 30 days of {issueDate}; record only an election filed on or before {deadline}.

election83bRecorded.message: An 83(b) election filed on {date} is already recorded.
election83bRecorded.remedy: Reverse the recorded election first if its date was entered in error.

mfnNotApplicable.remedy: Record MFN elections only on SAFEs issued with the MFN term.

mfnElectionClosed.message: Security {security} is {status, select, outstanding {outstanding} exercised {exercised} settled {settled} forfeited {forfeited} expired {expired} cancelled {cancelled} repurchased {repurchased} transferred {transferred} converted {converted} void {void} repaid {repaid} not_issued {not yet issued} other {no longer outstanding}} as of {date}; its terms can no longer change.
mfnElectionClosed.remedy: Record an election only while the SAFE is outstanding; correct a conversion by voiding the certificate it produced first.

mfnReversalClosedConverted.message: Security {security} is {status, select, outstanding {outstanding} exercised {exercised} settled {settled} forfeited {forfeited} expired {expired} cancelled {cancelled} repurchased {repurchased} transferred {transferred} converted {converted} void {void} repaid {repaid} not_issued {not yet issued} other {no longer outstanding}} as of {date}; its terms can no longer change.
mfnReversalClosedConverted.remedy: Void certificate {certificate}, which the conversion produced, dated {date} (the round's closing date), to undo the conversion; then reverse the election and convert {security} again.

mfnReversalClosed.message: Security {security} is {status, select, outstanding {outstanding} exercised {exercised} settled {settled} forfeited {forfeited} expired {expired} cancelled {cancelled} repurchased {repurchased} transferred {transferred} converted {converted} void {void} repaid {repaid} not_issued {not yet issued} other {no longer outstanding}} as of {date}; its terms can no longer change.
mfnReversalClosed.remedy: Reverse the {status, select, repaid {repayment} other {cancellation}} first, then reverse the election.

mfnBackdated.message: An MFN election or reversal on {security} is already recorded from {date}.
mfnBackdated.remedy: Date the {action, select, election {election} other {reversal}} on or after {date} under “{field}”.

mfnSourceNotConvertible.message: The instrument is not a SAFE or note of this legal entity.
mfnSourceNotConvertible.remedy: Choose a SAFE or convertible note issued after this SAFE.

mfnSourceNotLater.message: {source} was issued on {sourceIssuedOn}, not after {safe}, issued on {safeIssuedOn}.
mfnSourceNotLater.remedy: Choose an instrument issued after this SAFE; the MFN term covers later instruments only.

mfnSourceNotYetIssued.remedy: Set “{field}” on or after {issuedOn}, when {source} was issued.

mfnSourceVoid.remedy: Choose an instrument that stands; a void instrument's terms were entered in error.

mfnTermsAlreadyAdopted.message: {safe} already carries the terms of {source} from {date}.
mfnTermsAlreadyAdopted.remedy: Nothing to elect; the terms are already adopted.

mfnSourceNoTerms.message: {source} has neither a valuation cap nor a discount.
mfnSourceNoTerms.remedy: Choose an instrument with a cap or a discount the SAFE lacks or betters.

mfnTermsNotBetter.message: None of the terms of {source} is better than the terms of {safe} in force on {date}.
mfnTermsNotBetter.remedy: Choose an instrument whose cap is lower, discount higher or conversion post-money where the SAFE's is pre-money.

mfnElectionUnknown.message: The MFN election does not exist on this SAFE.
mfnElectionUnknown.remedy: Choose an election from the SAFE's MFN terms.

mfnElectionAlreadyReversed.message: The MFN election is already reversed.

mfnReversalBeforeElection.message: The reversal cannot precede the election, dated {date}.
mfnReversalBeforeElection.remedy: Date the reversal on or after {date}.

mfnReversalHasDependents.message: A later MFN election on {security} is recorded from {date}.
mfnReversalHasDependents.remedy: Reverse the election of {date} first, latest first.

actionRejected.message: This action was rejected by its approver.
actionRejected.remedy: Review the approver's reason, then record the action again with a new request key if it still applies.

actionWithdrawn.message: This action was withdrawn by its requester.
actionWithdrawn.remedy: Record the action again with a new request key if it still applies.

actionPending.message: {action, select, void {A void} reverse {A reversal} repurchase {A repurchase} repay {A repayment} cancel_convertible {A cancellation} class_amendment {A class amendment} split {A split} reserve_change {A reserve change} mfn_election {An MFN election} mfn_reversal {An MFN election reversal} compensation_run {A stock compensation run} interest_run {A note interest run} account_policy {An account policy version} round_amendment {A round amendment} round_void {A round void} other {An equity action}} of {subject} is already awaiting approval.
actionPending.remedy: Wait for the approver's decision, or withdraw the pending request from Inbox → Submitted by me, before recording another.

actionRoutingFailed.message: The equity action could not be routed for approval: {reason}.
actionRoutingFailed.remedy: Correct the Equity action Flow in Flows (or disable it), then record the action again.

actionChangedWhileApplied.message: The equity action changed while it was being applied.

actionChangedWhileWithdrawn.message: The equity action changed while it was being withdrawn.
actionChangedWhileWithdrawn.remedy: Reload the Inbox to see its outcome.

actionChangedWhileDecided.message: The equity action changed while it was being decided.
actionChangedWhileDecided.remedy: Reload the Inbox and decide it again if it is still pending.

withdrawalReasonRequired.message: Give a reason of {min} to {max} characters for withdrawing the action.
withdrawalReasonRequired.remedy: Explain why the action no longer applies, then withdraw it again.

actionUnknown.message: The equity action does not exist.

withdrawForbidden.message: Only the requester can withdraw an equity action.
withdrawForbidden.remedy: Ask the requester to withdraw it, or reject it from the Inbox if you are an approver named on its Flow.

actionDecidedNoWithdrawal.message: The equity action is {status, select, pending_approval {awaiting approval} applied {applied} rejected {rejected} withdrawn {withdrawn} other {decided}}, not awaiting approval, so it cannot be withdrawn.
actionDecidedNoWithdrawal.remedy: Reload the Inbox to see its outcome.

actionDecided.message: The equity action is {status, select, pending_approval {awaiting approval} applied {applied} rejected {rejected} withdrawn {withdrawn} other {decided}}, not awaiting approval.
actionDecided.remedy: Reload the Inbox to see its outcome.

approvalSignInRequired.message: An equity approval must be decided by a signed-in user.
approvalSignInRequired.remedy: Sign in and decide the approval from the Inbox.

selfApproval.message: The requester of an equity action cannot decide its approval.
selfApproval.remedy: Ask another approver named on the Flow's gate to decide it.

rejectionReasonRequired.message: Record the reason for rejecting the equity action.
rejectionReasonRequired.remedy: Add a comment explaining the rejection, then reject again.

accountPolicyEntityMissing.message: Choose the legal entity the policy applies to.
accountPolicyEntityMissing.remedy: Choose the legal entity, then save the policy version again.

accountPolicyEffectiveDateInvalid.message: Enter the date the policy takes effect.
accountPolicyEffectiveDateInvalid.remedy: Choose a valid date under “{field}”, then save the policy version again.

accountPolicyAccountMissing.remedy: Choose an account under “{account}”, then save the policy version again.

accountPolicyAccountType.message: “{account}” must be {kind, select, equity {an active equity posting account} expense {an active expense posting account} liabilityOrEquity {an active liability or equity posting account} liability {an active other current or long-term liability posting account} other {an active posting account of an accepted type}} of the organization.
accountPolicyAccountType.remedy: Choose {kind, select, equity {an active equity posting account} expense {an active expense posting account} liabilityOrEquity {an active liability or equity posting account} liability {an active other current or long-term liability posting account} other {an active posting account of an accepted type}} under “{account}”, then save the policy version again.

accountPolicyBeforeLatestPosting.message: Equity entries are posted through {date}; a new policy version must take effect after that date so posted history keeps its accounts.
accountPolicyBeforeLatestPosting.remedy: Record a new policy version effective after {date}, so it satisfies the current ledger.

exitValueInvalid.message: “{field}” must be an amount with at most {places} decimal {placesCount, plural, one {place} other {places}}.
exitValueInvalid.remedy: Enter “{field}” as an amount, such as {example}.

transactionFeesInvalid.message: “{field}” must be an amount with at most {places} decimal {placesCount, plural, one {place} other {places}}.
transactionFeesInvalid.remedy: Enter the fees paid from the exit under “{field}”, such as {example}, or leave it blank.

transactionFeesNegative.message: The transaction fees cannot be negative.
transactionFeesNegative.remedy: Enter the fees paid from the exit, or leave them blank.

transactionFeesExceedExit.message: The transaction fees exceed the exit value.
transactionFeesExceedExit.remedy: Enter fees no greater than the exit value.

exitValueNegative.message: The exit value cannot be negative.
exitValueNegative.remedy: Enter the proceeds available to equity holders.

waterfallUnsettled.message: The preferred classes' conversion choices do not settle at this exit value.
waterfallUnsettled.remedy: Review the classes' preferences, participation caps and seniority, or model a different exit value.

roundPreMoneyNotPositive.message: The pre-money valuation must be greater than zero.

roundInvestmentNotPositive.message: The investment must be greater than zero.

roundTargetPoolOutOfRange.message: The target pool must be at least {min} and below {max}.
roundTargetPoolOutOfRange.remedy: Enter the post-round pool target as a percentage.

roundNoShares.message: The company has no shares to price the round against.
roundNoShares.remedy: Record the company's issued shares before modelling a round.

roundUnpriceable.message: No positive price satisfies these terms: the converting instruments and pool top-up claim the whole pre-money valuation.
roundUnpriceable.remedy: Raise the pre-money valuation, lower the pool target, or review the caps and discounts of the converting instruments.

roundInvestmentBelowOneShare.message: The investment buys less than one share at the round price.
roundInvestmentBelowOneShare.remedy: Raise the investment or lower the pre-money valuation.

runPeriodNotEnded.message: The {run, select, compensation {stock compensation run} interest {note interest run} other {posting}} through {date} falls in {period}, which ends on {endsOn}, after today ({today}).
runPeriodNotEnded.remedy: Run through the end of a period that has ended by today ({today}); the runs view offers the next one with activity due, and anything recognized since the last run is caught up in it.

runPeriodClosed.message: The {run, select, compensation {stock compensation run} interest {note interest run} other {posting}} through {date} falls in {period}, which is closed for posting.
runPeriodClosed.remedy: Run through the end of an open period (the runs view offers the next one with activity due), or request a controlled reopen of {closing} through Period Close.

compensationRunBackdated.message: A stock compensation run through {last} is already posted.
compensationRunBackdated.remedy: Run through a date after {last}; earlier periods are already measured.

interestRunBackdated.message: A note interest run through {last} is already posted.
interestRunBackdated.remedy: Run through a date after {last}; earlier periods are already accrued.

compensationNothingDue.message: No stock compensation is due through {date}.
compensationNothingDue.remedy: Nothing changes in this period; run through a later period end once awards vest or are granted.

compensationNothingDueSince.message: No stock compensation is due through {date} beyond the run through {last}.
compensationNothingDueSince.remedy: Nothing changes in this period; run through a later period end once awards vest or are granted.

interestNothingDue.message: No note interest is due through {date}.
interestNothingDue.remedy: No note accrues interest in this period; run through a later period end while a note is outstanding.

interestNothingDueSince.message: No note interest is due through {date} beyond the run through {last}.
interestNothingDueSince.remedy: No note accrues interest in this period; run through a later period end while a note is outstanding.

interestBelowAccrued.message: Interest on {security} through {date} is below what is already accrued.
interestBelowAccrued.remedy: Review the note's interest entries and settlements in the journal; accrued interest only falls when a note is voided.

noteDayCountMissing.message: The note has no day-count convention.
noteDayCountMissing.remedy: Record the note's day count (Actual/365, Actual/360, 30/360 or Actual/Actual).

noteInterestBasisMissing.message: The note has no interest basis.
noteInterestBasisMissing.remedy: Record how the note's interest builds (simple, or compounded annually, semiannually, quarterly or monthly).

issuanceKindRequired.message: Choose what kind of security to issue.
issuanceKindRequired.remedy: Choose share, option, RSU, warrant, SAFE or note under “{field}”.

issuanceMemoTooLong.message: “{field}” is longer than {max} {maxCount, plural, one {character} other {characters}}.
issuanceMemoTooLong.remedy: Shorten “{field}” to at most {max} {maxCount, plural, one {character} other {characters}}.

issuanceClassRequired.message: Choose the share class of this legal entity the security is in.

issuanceClassNotYetEffective.remedy: Date the issuance on or after {date} under “{field}”.

issuancePlanKindInvalid.message: Only options and RSUs are granted from a plan.

issuancePlanClassMismatch.message: Plan {plan} grants awards over its own class.
issuancePlanClassMismatch.remedy: Choose the plan's share class under “{field}”.

issuancePlanNotYetEffective.remedy: Date the grant on or after {date} under “{field}”.

issuanceRoundKindInvalid.message: Only shares and warrants are issued in a round.

issuanceRoundClassMismatch.remedy: Choose the round's share class under “{field}”.

issuanceQuantityNotPositive.remedy: Enter at least one share under “{field}”.

issuanceConvertibleQuantity.message: SAFEs and notes are measured in money, not shares.

issuanceRoundCurrencyMismatch.remedy: Choose {currency} under “{field}”, or leave it blank to use the round's currency.

issuanceCurrencyInvalid.message: Choose the currency the security is stated in.
issuanceCurrencyInvalid.remedy: Choose a three-letter ISO currency code under “{field}”.

issuanceExercisePriceRequired.message: Enter the exercise price per share.

issuanceConvertiblePrice.message: A SAFE or note has no price per share.

issuanceRsuPrice.message: An RSU has no purchase or exercise price.

issuancePrincipalRequired.message: Enter the principal the investor paid.
issuancePrincipalRequired.remedy: Enter the purchase amount or note principal under “{field}”.

issuanceAwardConsideration.message: Awards are granted without consideration; the exercise price is paid on exercise.

issuanceVestingKindInvalid.message: Only shares, options and RSUs vest.

issuanceAccelerationRequired.remedy: Choose none, single trigger or double trigger under “{field}”.

issuanceAccelerationOutOfRange.message: “{field}” must be above {zero} and at most {hundred}.
issuanceAccelerationOutOfRange.remedy: Enter the share of unvested units that accelerates under “{field}”.

issuanceOptionTypeRequired.message: Choose whether the option is an incentive or non-qualified option.

issuanceRepurchaseBasisRequired.message: Choose the price at which the company repurchases unvested early-exercised shares.
issuanceRepurchaseBasisRequired.remedy: Choose cost, or the lower of cost and fair market value, under “{field}”.

issuanceRepurchaseBasisUnused.message: Only an early-exercisable option carries an unvested repurchase price.

issuanceSafeTypeRequired.message: Choose a pre-money or post-money SAFE.

issuanceMfnKindInvalid.message: Only a SAFE carries a most-favored-nation term.

issuanceCapDiscountKindInvalid.message: Only SAFEs and notes carry a cap or discount.

issuanceValuationCapNotPositive.remedy: Enter an amount greater than zero under “{field}”, or clear it.

issuanceDiscountOutOfRange.message: “{field}” must be at least {zero} and below {hundred}.
issuanceDiscountOutOfRange.remedy: Enter a discount from {zero} up to, but not including, {hundred} under “{field}”, or leave it blank for none.

issuanceInterestRateRequired.message: Enter the note's annual interest rate.
issuanceInterestRateRequired.remedy: Enter the annual rate under “{field}”, or zero for none.

issuanceInterestBasisRequired.message: Choose how the note's interest accrues.
issuanceInterestBasisRequired.remedy: Choose simple interest, or compounding annually, semiannually, quarterly or monthly, under “{field}”.

issuanceDayCountRequired.remedy: Choose Actual/365, Actual/360, 30/360 or Actual/Actual under “{field}”.

issuanceDayCountKindInvalid.message: Only a note carries a day-count convention.

issuanceAttributionRequired.message: Choose how the award's cost is attributed.

issuanceGrantSharePriceNotPositive.remedy: Enter the fair value of a share on the grant date under “{field}”.

issuanceValuationKindInvalid.message: Only options and RSUs carry a share-based payment valuation.

issuanceNumberTooLong.message: “{field}” is longer than {max} {maxCount, plural, one {character} other {characters}}.
issuanceNumberTooLong.remedy: Shorten “{field}” to at most {max} {maxCount, plural, one {character} other {characters}}.

securityNumberTaken.message: Security number {number} is already used by this legal entity.
securityNumberTaken.remedy: Enter a different number under “{field}”, or leave it blank to number it automatically.

issuanceBelowPar.message: The consideration is below the shares' par value.
issuanceBelowPar.remedy: Shares cannot be issued below par; enter the full consideration received under “{field}”.

issuanceParConsiderationRequired.message: Shares carry par value, so their issuance needs consideration.
issuanceParConsiderationRequired.remedy: Enter the cash received for the shares under “{field}” and the account that received it under “{account}”.

vestingShapesMixed.message: A schedule is either dated tranches or a time-based schedule, not both.
vestingShapesMixed.remedy: Remove the time-based terms or the tranches.

vestingTrancheDateInvalid.message: Every tranche needs a valid YYYY-MM-DD date.

vestingTranchesUnordered.message: Tranche dates must be distinct and in ascending order.
vestingTranchesUnordered.remedy: List each tranche once, earliest first.

vestingTrancheEmpty.message: Every tranche must vest at least one share.

vestingTranchesTotalMismatch.message: The tranches vest {total} {totalCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}, but the security carries {quantity} {quantityCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}.
vestingTranchesTotalMismatch.remedy: Make the tranche quantities sum to the security's quantity.

vestingCliffWithoutTerm.message: A cliff or frequency needs a vesting term in months.

vestingMonthsOutOfRange.message: “{field}” must be a whole number of months from {min} to {max}.
vestingMonthsOutOfRange.remedy: Enter a whole number of months from {min} to {max} under “{field}”.

vestingCliffOutOfRange.message: “{field}” must be a whole number of months within “{term}”.
vestingCliffOutOfRange.remedy: Enter whole months from {min} up to the value of “{term}” under “{field}”.

vestingFrequencyRequired.message: A time-based schedule needs a vesting frequency.
vestingFrequencyRequired.remedy: Choose monthly, quarterly or annual under “{field}”.

vestingStartRequired.message: A time-based schedule needs a vesting start date.

vestingStoredTranchesNotList.message: The stored vesting tranches are not a list.
vestingStoredTranchesNotList.remedy: Record the tranches as a list of dated whole-share quantities.

vestingStoredTrancheInvalid.message: A vesting tranche needs a YYYY-MM-DD date and a whole-share quantity.
vestingStoredTrancheInvalid.remedy: Correct the tranche dates and quantities.

valuationLogarithmUndefined.message: The logarithm needs a positive value.

valuationSharePriceNotPositive.remedy: Enter the fair value of a share on the grant date under “{field}”.

valuationVolatilityNotPositive.remedy: Enter the expected volatility as a percentage under “{field}”.

valuationTermNotPositive.remedy: Enter the expected term in years under “{field}”.

valuationDividendYieldNegative.remedy: Enter the expected dividend yield as a percentage under “{field}”, or zero for none.

awardFairValueNegative.message: Security {security} carries a negative fair value.

securityNotShareBased.remedy: Use the convertible view for SAFEs and notes.

holdingEventQuantityMissing.message: An event on {security} has no quantity.

holdingEventExceeded.message: The {kind, select, exercise {exercise} settle {settlement} forfeit {forfeiture} expire {expiry} cancel {cancellation} repurchase {repurchase} transfer {transfer} convert {conversion} other {event}} of {quantity} {quantityCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}} on {date} exceeds what {security} held.
holdingEventExceeded.remedy: Review the security's history; the recorded quantities cannot be replayed.

securityNotConvertible.message: Security {security} is not a convertible instrument.
securityNotConvertible.remedy: Choose a SAFE or a convertible note.

postMoneyOverclaim.message: The capped post-money SAFEs claim {limit} or more of the company, so the conversion has no meaningful solution.
postMoneyOverclaim.remedy: Check “{principal}” and “{cap}” of the post-money SAFEs; a cap entered in the wrong unit is the usual cause.

postMoneyUnsettled.message: The post-money conversion did not settle.

conversionPriceZero.message: The conversion price rounds to zero.
conversionPriceZero.remedy: Check the round price and the converting instruments’ “{cap}” and “{discount}”.

conversionRoundPriceNotPositive.message: The round price must be greater than zero.
conversionRoundPriceNotPositive.remedy: Enter the round price per share.

conversionNotOutstanding.message: Instrument {security} is not outstanding on {date}, the round's closing date.
conversionNotOutstanding.remedy: Check the instrument's issue date and history.

authorizedExceeded.message: Class {shareClass} would commit {committed} {committedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} on {date} but authorizes {authorized}.
authorizedExceeded.remedy: {purpose, select, authorized_amendment {Authorize at least {committed} {committedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} of class {shareClass}: its outstanding shares, outstanding awards and unallocated plan pools need them on {date}.} reserve_increase {Add no more than {room} {roomCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} to the reserve, or first record an authorized-share amendment raising class {shareClass} to at least {committed} {committedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}.} plan {Reserve no more than {room} {roomCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}, or first record an authorized-share amendment raising class {shareClass} to at least {committed} {committedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}.} reversal {Record an authorized-share amendment raising class {shareClass} to at least {committed} {committedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} before reversing the event.} other {Record an authorized-share amendment raising class {shareClass} to at least {committed} {committedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}, or issue {excess} fewer {excessCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}}.}}

poolExhausted.message: Plan {plan} would have {available} {availableCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} available on {date}.
poolExhausted.remedy: {action, select, reduce {Remove no more than {maximum} {maximumCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} from the reserve of plan {plan} from {from}; the rest is granted to awards.} empty {Plan {plan} has no unallocated shares to remove on or after {from}; forfeit or cancel awards first.} other {Grant {shortfall} fewer {shortfallCount, plural, one {unit} other {units}}, or first increase the reserve of plan {plan}.}}

classIdUnknown.message: The share class does not exist.

roundIdUnknown.remedy: Choose a round of the legal entity.

authorizedSharesNotPositive.remedy: Enter at least one share under “{field}”.

parValueNegative.message: The par value cannot be negative.
parValueNegative.remedy: Enter the par value per share under “{field}” (zero for no-par stock).

classKindInvalid.message: A share class is either common or preferred.

classSeniorityInvalid.message: Seniority must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
classSeniorityInvalid.remedy: Enter “{field}” as a whole number from {min} to {max}; a higher seniority is paid first.

preferredPricesNotPositive.message: Preferred stock needs a positive original issue price and conversion price.
preferredPricesNotPositive.remedy: Enter the price the class was sold at under “{issue}”, and a conversion price above zero under “{conversion}” if it differs.

liquidationMultipleNegative.message: The liquidation multiple cannot be negative.
liquidationMultipleNegative.remedy: Enter “{field}” as zero or more, such as {example}.

participationCapNotAboveMultiple.message: The participation cap of {cap} must exceed the liquidation multiple of {multiple}.

liquidationPreferenceBasisInvalid.message: Choose what the liquidation preference is measured on.
liquidationPreferenceBasisInvalid.remedy: Choose the amount paid for each certificate or the original issue price of the class under “{field}”.

classCodeTaken.message: Class code {code} is already used by this legal entity.

conversionClassRequired.message: Choose the common class the preferred shares convert into.
conversionClassRequired.remedy: Choose a common class of the legal entity under “{field}”, recording it first if needed.

conversionClassNotYetEffective.remedy: Date the class on or after {date}, or choose another conversion class.

conversionClassNotEffectiveForAmendment.remedy: Date the amendment on or after {date}.

conversionClassOnCommon.message: Only a preferred class converts into another class.

conversionClassAmendmentOnCommon.message: Only a preferred class converts into another class.

conversionPriceAmendmentOnCommon.message: Only a preferred class has a conversion price.

conversionPriceNotPositive.message: The conversion price must be greater than zero.
conversionPriceNotPositive.remedy: Enter the new conversion price under “{field}”.

classAmendmentBeforeClass.message: An amendment cannot precede the effective date of class {shareClass} ({date}).
classAmendmentBeforeClass.remedy: Date the amendment on or after {date}.

conversionClassSplitRecorded.message: A split of the conversion class is recorded on {date}; changing the conversion class before it would reinterpret it.

classAmendmentKindInvalid.remedy: Amend the authorized shares, the conversion price or the conversion class.

splitRatioInvalid.message: A split ratio needs two different positive whole numbers.
splitRatioInvalid.remedy: Enter the new and old share counts of the split under “{newShares}” and “{oldShares}”, such as 2 for 1 or 1 for 10.

splitBackdated.message: Class {shareClass} has activity recorded through {date}; a split must be dated after it.

splitBackdatedByConversion.message: Class {shareClass} converts into {splitClass} and has activity recorded through {date}; the split adjusts its conversion price, so it must be dated after that.

splitConversionClassMissing.message: Preferred {codes} {classesCount, plural, one {does not name the common class it converts into, so the effect of the split on its conversion price is unknown.} other {do not name the common class they convert into, so the effect of the split on their conversion price is unknown.}}
splitConversionClassMissing.remedy: Record the class each preferred class converts into (Share classes → Amend → “{field}”), then record the split.

planReserveNotPositive.remedy: Enter the shares reserved for the plan under “{field}”.

planBeforeClass.message: A plan cannot precede its share class, effective {date}.
planBeforeClass.remedy: Date the plan on or after {date}.

planCodeTaken.message: Plan code {code} is already used by this legal entity.

reserveChangeInvalid.message: The reserve change must be a nonzero whole number of shares.
reserveChangeInvalid.remedy: Enter the shares to add under “{field}”, or a negative number to remove shares.

reserveChangeBeforePlan.message: A reserve change cannot precede plan {plan}, effective {date}.
reserveChangeBeforePlan.remedy: Date the change on or after {date}.

preMoneyUnmeasurable.message: A pre-money valuation of {preMoney} cannot be checked against the round price of {price}: no shares are outstanding before the round.
preMoneyUnmeasurable.remedy: State the basis of the valuation under “{field}”.

preMoneyInconsistent.message: A pre-money valuation of {preMoney} does not match the round price of {price} times the {fullyDiluted} fully diluted {fullyDilutedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} before the round ({implied}).
preMoneyInconsistent.remedy: Enter a pre-money valuation of {implied} or a price per share of {impliedPrice}; if the valuation is stated on another basis (a pool increase or conversions counted in it), state that basis under “{field}”.

preMoneyInconsistentPriceLocked.message: A pre-money valuation of {preMoney} does not match the round price of {price} times the {fullyDiluted} fully diluted {fullyDilutedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} before the round ({implied}).
preMoneyInconsistentPriceLocked.remedy: Enter a pre-money valuation of {implied} (the price stays at {price}, since live securities were issued or converted at it); if the valuation is stated on another basis (a pool increase or conversions counted in it), state that basis under “{field}”.

preMoneyInconsistentValuationOnly.message: A pre-money valuation of {preMoney} does not match the round price of {price} times the {fullyDiluted} fully diluted {fullyDilutedCount, plural, one {share} other {shares}} before the round ({implied}).
preMoneyInconsistentValuationOnly.remedy: Enter a pre-money valuation of {implied}; if the valuation is stated on another basis (a pool increase or conversions counted in it), state that basis under “{field}”.

roundPricePerShareNotPositive.message: The price per share must be greater than zero.
roundPricePerShareNotPositive.remedy: Enter the price per share of the round under “{field}”.

roundPreMoneyValuationNotPositive.message: The pre-money valuation must be greater than zero.

roundBeforeClass.message: A round cannot close before its share class is effective on {date}.
roundBeforeClass.remedy: Date the round on or after {date}.

roundNameTaken.message: A round named {name} already exists for this legal entity, or did before it was renamed or voided.

roundNameTooLong.message: The round name must be at most {max} characters.

roundIsVoid.remedy: Record a new round if it is still needed; a void round takes no further changes.

roundTermsUnchanged.remedy: Change the name, the price per share or the pre-money valuation.

roundAmendmentBeforeClose.message: An amendment cannot precede the closing date of round {round} ({date}).
roundAmendmentBeforeClose.remedy: Date the amendment on or after {date}.

roundPriceLockedBySecurities.message: Round {round} has issued or converted {securities} at its price.
roundPriceLockedBySecurities.remedy: Void those certificates first (each void reverses its entry), then amend the price and record them again; or record the correct round and void this one once it is empty.

roundVoidBeforeClose.message: The void cannot precede the closing date of round {round} ({date}).
roundVoidBeforeClose.remedy: Date the void on or after {date}.

roundVoidHasSecurities.message: Round {round} still has {securities} issued or converted in it.
roundVoidHasSecurities.remedy: Void those certificates first (each void reverses its entry and returns a converted SAFE or note to outstanding), then void the round.

antiDilutionBaseMissing.message: The weighted-average adjustment needs the shares outstanding before the round.
antiDilutionBaseMissing.remedy: Record the outstanding shares of the company before modelling the round.
